title: ClaudeAgents telemetry config.json, v1
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the telemetry/config.json artefact written once at run start. The artefact records the framework's view of the project as of run start: the envelope (schema version + capture timestamp + run id) and the full ten-field getResolvedConfig() snapshot. The schema enumerates the ten resolvedConfig fields so a partial snapshot fails validation, which is the drift the spec exists to prevent. resolvedConfig.additionalProperties is true so a forward-compat field added under F3's additive-stays-on-vN rule still validates against v1.

isoDateTimeMs.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision. The pattern enforces the encoding directly so the bundled ajv (strict:true, no ajv-formats) accepts it without relying on format:date-time. The trailing Z and the .mmm fraction are required; local-timezone offsets are forbidden.

runId.description: Run identifier in the framework's <YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS>-<4 hex> form, the same canonical shape progress-v1 pins.

envelope.description: Capture metadata. schemaVersion is pinned to 1 so a future v2 reader can fail loudly when handed a v1 document rather than mis-parsing it.

resolvedConfig.description: The full getResolvedConfig() snapshot per F2: all ten top-level fields enumerated below. additionalProperties is intentionally true so a forward-compat field landed under F3's additive-stays-on-vN rule (e.g. a new top-level field added in a future minor) still validates against this v1 schema. Item shapes for the ten fields are intentionally unconstrained (kept as bare type:object/array/string) — the resolvedConfig structure is owned by F2's contract, and pinning its inner shape here would couple the telemetry schema to F2's evolution.
